title: crataegus suksdorfii
intro: Crataegus suksdorfii, commonly known as Suk's hawthorn, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular-protective properties, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The health benefits of Crataegus suksdorfii include reducing blood pressure, improving lipid profiles, and preventing cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of Suk's hawthorn include oligomeric proanthocyanidins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as vasodilation, antiplatelet aggregation, and antioxidant activity.
